text: 咬定青山不放松，立根原在破岩中
pinyin: yǎo dìng qīng shān bù fàng sōng, lì gēn yuán zài pò yán zhōng
literal: bite · fix · green · mountain · not · loosen, stand · root · originally · in · broken · rock · within
natural: clamped to the green mountain, never letting go, its roots stand firm in cracked rock

meaning.en: Like bamboo gripping a cliff, hold your ground and stay resolute however harsh the conditions.
meaning.zh: 像竹子紧咬青山、扎根岩缝一样，处境再艰难也坚定不移。

equivalents: stand firm like bamboo in the rock

examples.zh: 面对困难，他想起了“咬定青山不放松，立根原在破岩中”，决定再坚持一年。
examples.en: Facing difficulty, he recalled the line '{}' and decided to hold on for another year.

examples.zh: 校长用“咬定青山不放松，立根原在破岩中”勉励毕业生扎根基层。
examples.en: The head teacher used the line '{}' to urge graduates to put down roots at the grassroots.

origin.source: 郑燮《竹石》

story.en: Zheng Xie's poem 'Bamboo and Rock' praises bamboo that grows from a rock crevice and stays upright through gales from every direction.
story.zh: 郑燮（郑板桥）《竹石》借岩缝中的竹子，赞美不畏风雨、坚韧挺立的品格。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 我劝天公重抖擞，不拘一格降人才
pinyin: wǒ quàn tiān gōng chóng dǒu sǒu, bù jū yī gé jiàng rén cái
literal: I · urge · Heaven · again · rouse yourself, not · bound · one · mould · send down · talent
natural: I urge Heaven to rouse itself once more and send down talent of every kind

meaning.en: A plea for fresh energy and for recruiting talent without being confined to conventional moulds.
meaning.zh: 呼吁振作精神，打破常规，不拘一格选拔和使用人才。

equivalents: break the mould to find talent
talent should be sought in every form

examples.zh: 公司招聘时强调“我劝天公重抖擞，不拘一格降人才”，不看学历只看能力。
examples.en: The company stressed '{}' in hiring, looking at ability rather than degrees.

examples.zh: 教育改革的目标正是“我劝天公重抖擞，不拘一格降人才”。
examples.en: The aim of the education reform is precisely '{}'.

origin.source: 龚自珍《己亥杂诗》

story.en: Gong Zizhen wrote this in his 1839 sequence of miscellaneous poems, lamenting a stifled, lifeless age and calling on Heaven to bring forth talent.
story.zh: 龚自珍在《己亥杂诗》中感叹万马齐喑的局面，呼唤上天降下各种各样的人才。

usage.en: Often quoted in talk of recruitment and reform; the second half is the commoner citation.
usage.zh: 常用于谈人才选拔与改革，多引后半句。

text: 苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之
pinyin: gǒu lì guó jiā shēng sǐ yǐ, qǐ yīn huò fú bì qū zhī
literal: if · benefit · nation · life · death · by it, how · because · misfortune · fortune · avoid · rush to · it
natural: If it benefits the nation I will give my life; how could I dodge it or chase it for the sake of my own fortune?

meaning.en: To serve the country whatever the personal cost, without weighing private gain or loss.
meaning.zh: 只要对国家有利，就算付出生命也在所不惜，岂能因个人祸福而躲避或追求。

equivalents: serve the nation whatever the cost

examples.zh: 他把“苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之”写在办公室墙上，提醒自己。
examples.en: He wrote '{}' on his office wall as a reminder to himself.

examples.zh: 老专家一生隐姓埋名，真正做到了“苟利国家生死以，岂因祸福避趋之”。
examples.en: The veteran expert lived anonymously all his life, truly living by '{}'.

origin.source: 林则徐《赴戍登程口占示家人》

story.en: Lin Zexu, banished to Xinjiang after the Opium War crackdown, improvised this couplet for his family as he set out in 1842.
story.zh: 林则徐因禁烟获罪被遣戍新疆，临行口占此诗向家人表明心志。

usage.en: Solemn; used for patriotic devotion and public duty.
usage.zh: 庄重，多用于家国情怀与公共责任。

text: 海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚
pinyin: hǎi nà bǎi chuān, yǒu róng nǎi dà, bì lì qiān rèn, wú yù zé gāng
literal: sea · take in · hundred · rivers, have · tolerance · thus · great; cliff · stand · thousand · fathoms, no · desire · then · firm
natural: the sea takes in a hundred rivers, and tolerance makes it great; a cliff stands a thousand fathoms, and freedom from desire makes it strong

meaning.en: Breadth of mind brings greatness, and having no selfish wants gives a person unbending integrity.
meaning.zh: 胸怀宽广才能成就大业；没有私欲，才能刚正不阿。

equivalents: he who wants nothing fears nothing

examples.zh: 大学校训常引“海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚”，倡导包容与操守。
examples.en: University mottos often cite '{}', promoting tolerance and integrity.

examples.zh: 他在办公桌上挂着“海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚”的条幅。
examples.en: He hangs a scroll reading '{}' above his desk.

origin.source: 林则徐《题书房联》

story.en: A couplet traditionally attributed to Lin Zexu, said to have hung in his study and Guangzhou office as a personal motto.
story.zh: 相传为林则徐自题的书房联，也说悬于其广州官署，用作自勉。

usage.en: Often written as a couplet on scrolls; either half can be quoted alone.
usage.zh: 常作对联悬挂，上下联可单独引用。

text: 人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青
pinyin: rén shēng zì gǔ shéi wú sǐ, liú qǔ dān xīn zhào hàn qīng
literal: human · life · since · antiquity · who · lacks · death, leave · take · red · heart · illuminate · bamboo-slip history
natural: Who since ancient times has escaped death? Let me leave a loyal heart to shine in the annals of history

meaning.en: Everyone dies, so what matters is leaving behind a loyal, honourable name.
meaning.zh: 人总有一死，重要的是留下一片忠心，光照史册。

equivalents: death comes to all, honour lives on
leave a name in the annals

examples.zh: “人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青”，他在遗书中写道。
examples.en: '{}', he wrote in his farewell letter.

examples.zh: 读到“人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青”，同学们沉默了。
examples.en: On reading '{}', the students fell silent.

origin.source: 文天祥《过零丁洋》

story.en: Captured by Yuan forces in 1279, Wen Tianxiang was pressed to write urging Song loyalists to surrender; he answered with this poem and refused.
story.zh: 文天祥被元军俘获后，被逼写信招降宋军，他以此诗明志，拒绝投降。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁
pinyin: wáng shī běi dìng zhōng yuán rì, jiā jì wú wàng gào nǎi wēng
literal: royal · army · north · pacify · Central Plain · day, family · sacrifice · don't · forget · tell · your · old man
natural: When the royal army retakes the Central Plain in the north, do not forget to tell your father at the family sacrifice

meaning.en: A dying wish that the nation be reunified, to be reported at the ancestral rites.
meaning.zh: 临终嘱咐儿子：待国家收复中原统一之日，别忘了在家祭时告诉我。

equivalents: a dying wish for national reunion

examples.zh: 展览结尾引用了“王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁”，让许多观众红了眼眶。
examples.en: The exhibition ended with '{}', and many visitors teared up.

examples.zh: “王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁”，诗人至死都盼着国家统一。
examples.en: '{}': the poet hoped for reunification until his death.

origin.source: 陆游《示儿》

story.en: Lu You wrote 'To My Sons' on his deathbed, knowing he would not live to see the Southern Song recover the north.
story.zh: 陆游临终前作《示儿》，知道自己看不到南宋收复北方，只能嘱托儿孙。

usage.en: Moving, patriotic tone; also used of any hope handed to the next generation.
usage.zh: 情感沉痛，多表达爱国之情或对后人的嘱托。

text: 夜阑卧听风吹雨，铁马冰河入梦来
pinyin: yè lán wò tīng fēng chuī yǔ, tiě mǎ bīng hé rù mèng lái
literal: night · late · lie · listen · wind · blow · rain, iron · horses · ice · river · enter · dream · come
natural: Late at night I lie listening to wind and rain; armoured horses and frozen rivers enter my dreams

meaning.en: Even in old age and retirement, one still dreams of battlefield service for one's country.
meaning.zh: 夜深躺着听风雨声，梦中仍是披甲战马、冰封河山，表达报国之志不衰。

examples.zh: 退伍多年，他仍常梦见“夜阑卧听风吹雨，铁马冰河入梦来”。
examples.en: Years after leaving the army, he still often dreams of '{}'.

examples.zh: 作者用“夜阑卧听风吹雨，铁马冰河入梦来”写出了老将的壮志未酬。
examples.en: The author uses '{}' to convey an old general's unfulfilled ambition.

origin.source: 陆游《十一月四日风雨大作》

story.en: Written in 1192, when Lu You, in his late sixties and living in the country, heard a storm and dreamed of recovering the north.
story.zh: 陆游晚年闲居山阴，风雨之夜写下此诗，梦中仍是收复北方的战场。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 位卑未敢忘忧国，事定犹须待阖棺
pinyin: wèi bēi wèi gǎn wàng yōu guó, shì dìng yóu xū dài hé guān
literal: rank · low · not yet · dare · forget · worry · country, matter · settled · still · must · await · close · coffin
natural: Though my rank is low I dare not forget the nation's troubles; a person's worth is settled only when the coffin lid closes

meaning.en: Humble standing does not excuse indifference to the country, and a life can only be judged at its end.
meaning.zh: 地位低微也不敢忘记忧虑国事；对人的评价，要到盖棺才能论定。

equivalents: judge a life only at its close

examples.zh: “位卑未敢忘忧国，事定犹须待阖棺”，普通教师也有家国情怀。
examples.en: '{}': even an ordinary teacher can care about the nation.

examples.zh: 他用“位卑未敢忘忧国，事定犹须待阖棺”来回应质疑。
examples.en: He answered his critics with '{}'.

origin.source: 陆游《病起书怀》

story.en: Lu You wrote this in 1177 after recovering from illness while holding a minor post in Chengdu.
story.zh: 陆游病愈后在成都任闲职，书写心怀，表明不忘国事。

usage.en: Often only the first half is quoted as 位卑未敢忘忧国.
usage.zh: 常单引上半句“位卑未敢忘忧国”。

text: 零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故
pinyin: líng luò chéng ní niǎn zuò chén, zhǐ yǒu xiāng rú gù
literal: fall · scatter · become · mud · crushed · become · dust, only · have · fragrance · as · before
natural: fallen and trampled into mud and dust, only its fragrance remains as before

meaning.en: Even when ruined or cast aside, true integrity keeps its quality.
meaning.zh: 即使凋落、被碾成尘土，高洁的品质依然不变。

examples.zh: “零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故”，说的正是他不改初心的品格。
examples.en: '{}' describes exactly his character of never abandoning his original aim.

examples.zh: 老教授晚景清贫，却依然“零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故”。
examples.en: The old professor lived frugally in old age, yet remained as he was: '{}'.

origin.source: 陆游《卜算子·咏梅》

story.en: In this ci poem on the plum blossom, Lu You compares the flower, left alone by the broken bridge, to a person who keeps integrity unrecognised.
story.zh: 陆游《卜算子·咏梅》以驿外断桥边的寂寞梅花，比喻不与人争、高洁不改的品格。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 小楼一夜听春雨，深巷明朝卖杏花
pinyin: xiǎo lóu yī yè tīng chūn yǔ, shēn xiàng míng zhāo mài xìng huā
literal: small · upper room · one · night · listen · spring · rain, deep · lane · tomorrow · morning · sell · apricot · blossom
natural: I listen to spring rain all night in my little loft; tomorrow morning apricot blossoms will be sold in the deep lanes

meaning.en: A picture of spring arriving, with rain overnight and blossom for sale the next day.
meaning.zh: 春雨一夜，明早深巷里便有人叫卖杏花，描绘春意盎然的景象。

equivalents: a spring rain night, blossom at dawn

examples.zh: 窗外下了一夜雨，我想起“小楼一夜听春雨，深巷明朝卖杏花”。
examples.en: It rained all night outside, and I thought of '{}'.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“小楼一夜听春雨，深巷明朝卖杏花”，写出了江南春天的意境。
examples.en: The essay cites '{}' to evoke the mood of spring in the south.

origin.source: 陆游《临安春雨初霁》

story.en: Lu You wrote this in Lin'an (Hangzhou) in 1186, summoned to the capital and idle in lodgings as spring rain gave way to clear skies.
story.zh: 陆游被召至临安，客居无事，春雨初晴之际写下此诗。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处
pinyin: zhòng lǐ xún tā qiān bǎi dù, mò rán huí shǒu, nà rén què zài, dēng huǒ lán shān chù
literal: crowd · among · seek · her · thousand · hundred · times, suddenly · turn · head, that · person · yet · is · lantern · fire · dim · place
natural: I searched for her in the crowd a thousand times; suddenly I turned, and there she was where the lantern light was dim

meaning.en: After long, fruitless searching, the thing you wanted turns up unexpectedly in a quiet place.
meaning.zh: 苦苦寻找多次不得，不经意回头，却发现要找的人（或答案）就在灯火冷落处。

equivalents: the search ends where you least expect

examples.zh: 科研三年毫无头绪，直到“众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处”，答案原来就在最初的数据里。
examples.en: After three years of fruitless research, '{}': the answer had been in the original data all along.

examples.zh: 王国维用这句词比喻治学的第三重境界：“众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处”。
examples.en: Wang Guowei used this ci as the third stage of scholarship: '{}'.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《青玉案·元夕》

story.en: Xin Qiji's Lantern Festival ci describes a crowded night of festivities, ending on a solitary figure standing apart, away from the glitter.
story.zh: 辛弃疾写元宵夜灯火辉煌、游人如织，末尾却在冷落处找到那位独立的人。

usage.en: Often cited for sudden insight or love found; 王国维 made it the third 'stage' of learning.
usage.zh: 常用于顿悟或意外寻得所爱；王国维以之为治学第三境。

text: 青山遮不住，毕竟东流去
pinyin: qīng shān zhē bù zhù, bì jìng dōng liú qù
literal: green · mountains · block · cannot, after all · east · flow · go
natural: green hills cannot block it; in the end the river still flows east

meaning.en: Nothing can hold back a great tide of history or a determined cause.
meaning.zh: 青山再多也挡不住江水，比喻历史潮流或正义力量终究不可阻挡。

equivalents: nothing can block the flow of history

examples.zh: “青山遮不住，毕竟东流去”，改革的大势是挡不住的。
examples.en: '{}': the tide of reform cannot be stopped.

examples.zh: 她引用“青山遮不住，毕竟东流去”，表示自己不会放弃梦想。
examples.en: She quoted '{}' to say she would not give up her dream.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《菩萨蛮·书江西造口壁》

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote this on a wall at Zaokou in Jiangxi, looking at the river and recalling the Jin invasion and his wish to recover the north.
story.zh: 辛弃疾途经江西造口，题壁抒怀，借江水东流寄托收复失地的愿望。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 明月别枝惊鹊，清风半夜鸣蝉
pinyin: míng yuè bié zhī jīng què, qīng fēng bàn yè míng chán
literal: bright · moon · leave · branch · startle · magpie, clear · breeze · half · night · sing · cicada
natural: a bright moon startles the magpie from its branch; in the breeze at midnight a cicada sings

meaning.en: A vivid summer-night scene of moonlight, breeze and sounds in the countryside.
meaning.zh: 明月升起惊飞树枝上的喜鹊，半夜清风中蝉声响起，描绘夏夜乡村景色。

equivalents: a summer night in the countryside

examples.zh: 山村夜晚，真是“明月别枝惊鹊，清风半夜鸣蝉”。
examples.en: A village night really is '{}'.

examples.zh: 语文课上我们背诵了“明月别枝惊鹊，清风半夜鸣蝉”。
examples.en: In Chinese class we recited '{}'.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《西江月·夜行黄沙道中》

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote this ci while travelling by night on the Huangsha road, during his years of retirement in Jiangxi.
story.zh: 辛弃疾闲居江西期间，夜行黄沙岭时所作，描写夏夜田园风光。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 少年不识愁滋味，爱上层楼
pinyin: shào nián bù shí chóu zī wèi, ài shàng céng lóu
literal: youth · not · know · sorrow · taste, love · climb · tiers · tower
natural: as a youth I knew nothing of sorrow's taste, and loved to climb the tall tower

meaning.en: Young people, not yet knowing real hardship, enjoy melancholy and even pretend to sorrow.
meaning.zh: 年少时不懂真正的愁苦，喜欢登楼眺望、无病呻吟。

examples.zh: “少年不识愁滋味，爱上层楼”，回头看高中时写的日记，真是太矫情了。
examples.en: '{}': looking back at my school diary, it all seems so affected.

examples.zh: 他说自己是“少年不识愁滋味，爱上层楼”，那时以为失恋就是天大的事。
examples.en: He says he was '{}': back then a break-up seemed the end of the world.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《丑奴儿·书博山道中壁》

story.en: Xin Qiji wrote this on a wall on the road to Boshan; the first stanza recalls youthful, invented sorrow.
story.zh: 辛弃疾题于博山道中的墙壁，上阕回忆少年时为写新词而强说愁。

usage.en: Pairs with 而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休 to contrast youth and experience.
usage.zh: 常与“而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休”对照。

text: 而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休
pinyin: ér jīn shí jìn chóu zī wèi, yù shuō huán xiū
literal: now · know · fully · sorrow · taste, want · speak · yet · stop
natural: now I know sorrow through and through, and when I would speak of it, I stop

meaning.en: Real sorrow is too deep for words, so one says nothing or talks about something else.
meaning.zh: 如今饱尝愁苦，反而不想多说，欲言又止。

equivalents: words fail those who suffer most

examples.zh: “而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休”，他只轻轻说了一句“还行”。
examples.en: '{}': he only said quietly, 'Not bad.'

examples.zh: 人到中年，才懂得“而今识尽愁滋味，欲说还休”的分量。
examples.en: Only in middle age do we feel the weight of '{}'.

origin.source: 辛弃疾《丑奴儿·书博山道中壁》

story.en: The second stanza of Xin Qiji's ci contrasts the youthful pose with the unspoken grief of a man who has known setbacks.
story.zh: 此词下阕写词人历经世事，愁苦深重，反而欲言又止。

usage.en: Usually quoted in contrast with the youthful line before it.
usage.zh: 多与前句“少年不识愁滋味”对照引用。

text: 明月几时有，把酒问青天
pinyin: míng yuè jǐ shí yǒu, bǎ jiǔ wèn qīng tiān
literal: bright · moon · what · time · exist, hold · wine · ask · blue · sky
natural: when did the bright moon first appear? Cup in hand, I ask the blue sky

meaning.en: An opening of wonder at the moon, often quoted at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
meaning.zh: 明月是什么时候有的？端着酒杯问天，表达对宇宙人生的追问。

equivalents: raising a cup to the moon

examples.zh: 中秋晚会开场，主持人吟道：“明月几时有，把酒问青天”。
examples.en: The Mid-Autumn gala opened with the host reciting: '{}'.

examples.zh: 每到中秋，我就想起“明月几时有，把酒问青天”。
examples.en: Every Mid-Autumn I think of '{}'.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: On Mid-Autumn night 1076, Su Shi, drinking until dawn, wrote this ci missing his brother Su Zhe.
story.zh: 1076年中秋，苏轼通宵饮酒，怀念弟弟苏辙，作此词。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全
pinyin: rén yǒu bēi huān lí hé, yuè yǒu yīn qíng yuán quē, cǐ shì gǔ nán quán
literal: people · have · sorrow · joy · parting · reunion, moon · has · dim · clear · full · waning, this · matter · since antiquity · hard · complete
natural: people have sorrow and joy, parting and reunion, as the moon waxes and wanes; perfection has always been hard to find

meaning.en: Life's ups and downs are as natural as the moon's phases, so accept imperfection.
meaning.zh: 人生有悲欢离合，如同月亮有阴晴圆缺，自古没有十全十美的事。

equivalents: life has its ups and downs

examples.zh: “人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全”，想开些，下次再来。
examples.en: '{}'. Cheer up and try again next time.

examples.zh: 作文结尾引用“人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全”，劝人坦然面对得失。
examples.en: The essay ends with '{}', urging calm acceptance of gain and loss.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: From the same Mid-Autumn ci: Su Shi consoles himself on his separation from his brother, seeing partings as part of life's natural pattern.
story.zh: 同出中秋词：苏轼思念胞弟，转而自我宽解，把离别看作人生常态。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒
pinyin: wǒ yù chéng fēng guī qù, yòu kǒng qióng lóu yù yǔ, gāo chù bù shèng hán
literal: I · wish · ride · wind · return · go, yet · fear · jade · tower · jade · hall, high · place · not · bear · cold
natural: I would ride the wind back to heaven, but fear that in the jade towers it is too cold at such heights

meaning.en: The loneliness of the high-placed, or hesitation between lofty withdrawal and ordinary life.
meaning.zh: 想乘风回到天上，又怕天上寒冷难耐；比喻位高者孤独，或在出世与入世间犹豫。

examples.zh: 坐到这个位置才懂得“我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒”。
examples.en: Only after reaching this position did I understand '{}'.

examples.zh: “我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒”，他最终选择留在人间。
examples.en: '{}': in the end he chose to stay in the world.

origin.source: 苏轼《水调歌头·明月几时有》

story.en: In the same ci, Su Shi imagines escaping to the moon palace but decides the human world, with its dancing shadows, is better.
story.zh: 同一首词中，苏轼设想飞升月宫，又觉高处寒冷，终究眷恋人间。

usage.en: Often shortened to 高处不胜寒 for loneliness at the top.
usage.zh: 常缩为“高处不胜寒”，指位高孤独。

text: 乱石穿空，惊涛拍岸，卷起千堆雪
pinyin: luàn shí chuān kōng, jīng tāo pāi àn, juǎn qǐ qiān duī xuě
literal: jumbled · rocks · pierce · sky, startling · waves · slap · shore, roll · up · thousand · heaps · snow
natural: jagged rocks pierce the sky and startling waves beat the shore, rolling up a thousand drifts of snow

meaning.en: A grand description of rocks and surging waves at a river cliff.
meaning.zh: 描写赤壁江岸乱石高耸、惊涛拍岸、浪花如雪的壮阔景象。

examples.zh: 海边观潮，只见“乱石穿空，惊涛拍岸，卷起千堆雪”。
examples.en: Watching the tide, we saw '{}'.

examples.zh: 老师要求背诵“乱石穿空，惊涛拍岸，卷起千堆雪”这一名句。
examples.en: The teacher asked us to memorise the famous lines '{}'.

origin.source: 苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》

story.en: Su Shi wrote this ci in 1082 at Red Cliff in Huangzhou, a spot he took to be the site of the great battle of the Three Kingdoms.
story.zh: 苏轼谪居黄州，游览赤壁（实为“文赤壁”）时所作，借景怀古。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 羽扇纶巾，谈笑间，樯橹灰飞烟灭
pinyin: yǔ shàn guān jīn, tán xiào jiān, qiáng lǔ huī fēi yān miè
literal: feather · fan · silk · headband, talk · laugh · between, mast · oar · ash · fly · smoke · vanish
natural: with feather fan and silk headband, amid talk and laughter, enemy ships turned to flying ash and vanishing smoke

meaning.en: A commander wins a great victory with calm, confident ease.
meaning.zh: 指挥若定、谈笑自如之间，就让强敌化为灰烬，形容从容取胜。

examples.zh: 主教练“羽扇纶巾，谈笑间，樯橹灰飞烟灭”，指挥球队逆转取胜。
examples.en: The coach, '{}', led the team to a comeback win.

examples.zh: 他在谈判桌上“羽扇纶巾，谈笑间，樯橹灰飞烟灭”，轻松拿下合同。
examples.en: At the negotiating table, '{}', he easily won the contract.

origin.source: 苏轼《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》

story.en: The ci pictures Zhou Yu, young and elegant, burning Cao Cao's fleet at the Battle of Red Cliff.
story.zh: 词中追想周瑜在赤壁之战中从容指挥，火烧曹操战船。

usage.en: Describes Zhou Yu at Red Cliff; used of calm mastery.
usage.zh: 原写周瑜赤壁之战，现形容从容取胜。

text: 十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘
pinyin: shí nián shēng sǐ liǎng máng máng, bù sī liáng, zì nán wàng
literal: ten · years · living · dead · both · vast · vague, not · think · measure, yet · hard · forget
natural: ten years, the living and the dead lost to each other; I do not try to think of you, yet cannot forget

meaning.en: Grief for a lost loved one that endures without being summoned.
meaning.zh: 与亡者阴阳相隔十年，即使不去想念，也难以忘怀。

examples.zh: 清明扫墓，他想起“十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘”。
examples.en: At the Qingming tomb-sweeping, he thought of '{}'.

examples.zh: 这首悼亡词中“十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘”最为动人。
examples.en: '{}' is the most moving line in this elegy.

origin.source: 苏轼《江城子·乙卯正月二十日夜记梦》

story.en: Su Shi wrote this in 1075 after dreaming of his first wife, Wang Fu, who had died ten years earlier.
story.zh: 1075年苏轼梦见亡妻王弗，醒后写下这首悼亡词。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 莫听穿林打叶声，何妨吟啸且徐行
pinyin: mò tīng chuān lín dǎ yè shēng, hé fáng yín xiào qiě xú xíng
literal: don't · listen · pierce · forest · strike · leaves · sound, why · harm · chant · whistle · and · slowly · walk
natural: pay no heed to the rain rattling through the trees; why not chant and stroll on slowly?

meaning.en: Meet setbacks with composure and keep going, unmoved by the clamour.
meaning.zh: 不要在意穿林打叶的风雨声，何妨一边吟诗一边从容前行；面对挫折保持镇定。

examples.zh: 遇到挫折，他对自己说：“莫听穿林打叶声，何妨吟啸且徐行”。
examples.en: Meeting setbacks, he told himself: '{}'.

examples.zh: 毕业致辞里，校长引用了“莫听穿林打叶声，何妨吟啸且徐行”。
examples.en: In the graduation speech the principal quoted '{}'.

origin.source: 苏轼《定风波·莫听穿林打叶声》

story.en: Caught in rain on the road to Shahu in 1082 during his exile in Huangzhou, Su Shi stayed calm while his companions panicked, and wrote this ci.
story.zh: 苏轼被贬黄州，在沙湖道中遇雨，同行狼狈，他却从容而行，作此词。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕？一蓑烟雨任平生
pinyin: zhú zhàng máng xié qīng shèng mǎ, shéi pà, yī suō yān yǔ rèn píng shēng
literal: bamboo · staff · straw · sandals · lighter · beat · horse, who · fears, one · cloak · mist · rain · let · lifetime
natural: a bamboo staff and straw sandals are lighter than a horse; who is afraid? In a coir cloak I take whatever mist and rain life brings

meaning.en: Facing life's storms with a carefree, unafraid heart.
meaning.zh: 拄竹杖穿草鞋比骑马更轻快，何惧风雨？披着蓑衣任凭一生风雨，表现旷达洒脱。

examples.zh: 被裁员后他说：“竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕？一蓑烟雨任平生”。
examples.en: After being laid off he said: '{}'.

examples.zh: 她把“竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕？一蓑烟雨任平生”设为手机签名。
examples.en: She set '{}' as her phone status.

origin.source: 苏轼《定风波·莫听穿林打叶声》

story.en: From the same ci: the rain becomes a metaphor for life's setbacks, which the poet meets with an easy heart.
story.zh: 同一首词：以风雨比喻人生挫折，表现作者旷达的胸襟。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 枝上柳绵吹又少，天涯何处无芳草
pinyin: zhī shàng liǔ mián chuī yòu shǎo, tiān yá hé chù wú fāng cǎo
literal: branch · on · willow · fluff · blown · again · fewer, sky · edge · what · place · lacks · fragrant · grass
natural: the willow catkins on the branch are blown thinner still; but where under heaven is there no fragrant grass?

meaning.en: Comfort for disappointment: there are other chances, and other people, elsewhere.
meaning.zh: 柳絮越吹越少，但天涯到处都有芳草；用来安慰失意的人，别处还有机会。

equivalents: there are plenty more fish in the sea

examples.zh: 别难过了，“枝上柳绵吹又少，天涯何处无芳草”，下一个会更好。
examples.en: Don't be sad: '{}', the next one will be better.

examples.zh: 落选之后，朋友发来“枝上柳绵吹又少，天涯何处无芳草”。
examples.en: After the failed bid, a friend sent '{}'.

origin.source: 苏轼《蝶恋花·花褪残红青杏小》

story.en: Su Shi's ci describes spring fading and a wall-side girl's laughter fading too; the line is the poet's wry consolation.
story.zh: 词写春光渐逝，墙里佳人笑声渐悄，“天涯何处无芳草”是作者的自我宽解。

usage.en: Often shortened to 天涯何处无芳草, especially to console after a break-up.
usage.zh: 常缩为“天涯何处无芳草”，多用于失恋安慰。

text: 横看成岭侧成峰，远近高低各不同
pinyin: héng kàn chéng lǐng cè chéng fēng, yuǎn jìn gāo dī gè bù tóng
literal: across · look · become · ridge · side · become · peak, far · near · high · low · each · not · same
natural: seen from the front a ridge, from the side a peak; far or near, high or low, each view differs

meaning.en: Where you stand shapes what you see, so look at things from different angles.
meaning.zh: 从不同角度看，同一座山形态各异；比喻观察事物的立场、角度不同，结论也不同。

equivalents: it depends how you look at it

examples.zh: “横看成岭侧成峰，远近高低各不同”，同一件事，每个人的看法不尽相同。
examples.en: '{}': the same event looks different to each person.

examples.zh: 写论述文时，作者用“横看成岭侧成峰，远近高低各不同”说明看问题要全面。
examples.en: In an argumentative essay, the writer uses '{}' to show that one should see an issue fully.

origin.source: 苏轼《题西林壁》

story.en: Su Shi wrote this on the wall of Xilin Temple on Mount Lu in 1084, noting that you cannot see the mountain's true face from inside it.
story.zh: 1084年苏轼游庐山，题于西林寺壁，说明身在山中难识庐山真面目。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。
